answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with vault-backed identity: each identity locks a real outside-money deposit in a time-locked vault, opened only after a live beacon inspection where an independent auditor interviews the operator at a real address. Random echo checks then demand the same human appear on camera within minutes; a miss forfeits the deposit. The deposit doubles per identity on the same funding trail, and one operator cannot staff two live echo checks at once. Every extra fake costs another real address, another on-camera human, and twice the prior deposit.
